note: FH.14 host narrowing for a client with no host. A Locust load generator (loadgen/, a requirements.txt project) calls `GET /` with no host and no base, the shape of microservices-demo's src/loadgenerator. Two services serve `GET /`: the Go storefront (frontend/, gorilla mux, three HTTP routes) and an ASP.NET gRPC service (cartservice/, MapGrpcService plus the template's one incidental `MapGet("/")`). Before FH.14 the client paired with BOTH routes (CB.12's host narrowing needs a host to act on); after it, a candidate whose service serves gRPC and no other HTTP route is out of a host-less client's ladder, so only the frontend route pairs. Recall alone cannot see the wrong pair, so the precision gate is the forbid row. Deliberately not bound to a matrix cell: python/http_client, go/http_server and csharp/http_server are scored elsewhere.
